portal_invites.title: Family Portal Invites
portal_invites.subtitle: Invite guardians and catechumens to follow meetings, attendance and documents in the family portal — without pastoral admin access.
portal_invites.how_1: You send an invite with email and role (guardian or catechumen).
portal_invites.how_2: They open the link (email or WhatsApp) on the family portal.
portal_invites.how_3: They sign up or log in with the same email and accept the invite.
portal_invites.how_4: They only see their own family / their own profile.
portal_invites.how_note: WhatsApp is only for sharing the link. Login is always by email. Family users never see roll call, class admin or billing.
portal_invites.link_ready: Link ready to copy or share on WhatsApp

portal_invites.empty_desc: When you invite a guardian or catechumen, status appears here to resend or copy the link.
portal_invites.tip_context: Tip: you can also invite from the family or catechumen page. This hub lists all portal invites.
